description: Learn Tailwind CSS layout tools including Flexbox, CSS Grid, container, box-sizing, display, dimensions, positioning, and z-index.

slides.title: Introduction to Tailwind Layout
slides.content:
# Layout & Spacing in Tailwind CSS 📐

Positioning elements and structuring pages is where Tailwind truly shines. It provides high-level utilities for:

- **Container** — Centered max-width boundaries
- **Display & Box Sizing** — `block`, `inline-flex`, `box-border`
- **Flexbox** — Modern 1D layouts with direction and alignment
- **CSS Grid** — Multi-column 2D responsive grids
- **Spacing Scale** — Proportional padding and margin scales
- **Dimensions** — Fixed, percentage, and fluid width/height
- **Positioning & Z-Index** — `relative`, `absolute`, `sticky`, and stacking order

slides.title: The Container Component
slides.content:

Use `mx-auto` and `px-*`: ```html_not

slides.title: Display & Box Sizing
slides.content:
# Display & Box Sizing Utilities 🔲

Tailwind provides direct utility classes for all standard CSS `display` and `box-sizing` values.

## Display Classes

| Class | CSS Equivalent | Typical Usage |
|---|---|---|
| `block` | `display: block;` | Full width elements |
| `inline-block` | `display: inline-block;` | Badges, tags with margins |
| `inline` | `display: inline;` | Text spans, formatted inline phrases |
| `flex` | `display: flex;` | Flexbox container |
| `inline-flex` | `display: inline-flex;` | Inline icon + text buttons |
| `grid` | `display: grid;` | CSS Grid container |
| `hidden` | `display: none;` | Hiding elements (toggle with `md:block`) |

## Box Sizing
- `box-border` (`box-sizing: border-box;`) — Preflight default for all elements.
- `box-content` (`box-sizing: content-box;`) — Excludes padding and border from dimensions.

slides.title: Flexbox: Direction & Wrapping
slides.content:
# Flexbox: Direction & Wrapping 🔄 Turn any container into a flex container using `flex` or `inline-flex`. ## Flex Direction - `flex-row` — Left to right (default) - `flex-row-reverse` — Right to left - `flex-col` — Top to bottom (stacked column) - `flex-col-reverse` — Bottom to top ## Flex Wrapping - `flex-wrap` — Allow items to wrap onto multiple lines - `flex-nowrap` — Force items onto a single line - `flex-wrap-reverse` — Wrap items upwards ```html_not

slides.title: Flexbox: Alignment & Justification
slides.content:
# Flex Alignment & Justification 🎯

Positioning items along the main axis and cross axis is handled with `justify-*` and `items-*`.

## Main Axis: `justify-*`

| Class | CSS Value | Visual Result |
|---|---|---|
| `justify-start` | `flex-start` | Packed at the start |
| `justify-end` | `flex-end` | Packed at the end |
| `justify-center` | `center` | Centered along main axis |
| `justify-between` | `space-between` | Equal space between items |
| `justify-around` | `space-around` | Space around each item |
| `justify-evenly` | `space-evenly` | Equal spacing including ends |

## Cross Axis: `items-*`

- `items-center` — Center items across the perpendicular axis (`align-items: center`)
- `items-start` — Align to top / start
- `items-end` — Align to bottom / end
- `items-stretch` — Stretch items to fill height (default)

slides.title: Flexbox: Sizing & Shrinking
slides.content:
# Flex Item Sizing: Grow, Shrink & Basis 📏 Control how individual flex children expand and contract to fill available space. ## Flex Utilities for Children | Class | CSS | Description | |---|---|---| | `flex-1` | `flex: 1 1 0%;` | Grow and shrink proportionally ignoring initial size | | `flex-auto` | `flex: 1 1 auto;` | Grow and shrink taking initial item size into account | | `flex-initial` | `flex: 0 1 auto;` | Allow shrink but prevent growing past content size | | `flex-none` | `flex: none;` | Fixed size; cannot grow or shrink | | `grow` | `flex-grow: 1;` | Allow element to fill available space | | `shrink-0` | `flex-shrink: 0;` | Prevent element (e.g. icon/avatar) from squishing | ```html_not

Long message text that truncates cleanly...

```

slides.title: Grid Gutters & Spacing with Gap
slides.content:
# Gap: Gutters for Grid & Flexbox 📐 The `gap` utilities set gutters between rows and columns without affecting exterior edges. ## Gap Utilities - `gap-{size}` — Sets both horizontal and vertical gutters (e.g., `gap-4` = `1rem`) - `gap-x-{size}` — Sets column gutter only (`column-gap`) - `gap-y-{size}` — Sets row gutter only (`row-gap`) ```html_not
Wide horizontal gap
between these two columns
And smaller vertical
gap between these rows
``` > 💡 **Modern Tip:** `gap` works identically in both Flexbox (`flex`) and CSS Grid (`grid`) containers!

slides.title: The Spacing Scale: Padding & Margin
slides.content:
# The Tailwind Spacing Scale 📏

Tailwind's spacing scale is proportional where `1 unit = 0.25rem (4px)`.

## Spacing Reference Table

| Class Scale | CSS Value | Pixels (default 16px root) |
|---|---|---|
| `p-1`, `m-1` | `0.25rem` | 4px |
| `p-2`, `m-2` | `0.5rem` | 8px |
| `p-4`, `m-4` | `1rem` | 16px |
| `p-6`, `m-6` | `1.5rem` | 24px |
| `p-8`, `m-8` | `2rem` | 32px |
| `p-12`, `m-12` | `3rem` | 48px |
| `p-16`, `m-16` | `4rem` | 64px |

## Directional Prefixes
- `t` (top), `b` (bottom), `l` (left), `r` (right)
- `x` (left & right), `y` (top & bottom)
- Examples: `pt-4` (padding-top: 16px), `mx-auto` (horizontal margin: auto), `-mt-2` (negative margin-top: -8px)

slides.title: Dimensions: Width & Height
slides.content:
# Width & Height Utilities 📐

Tailwind provides fixed scale dimensions, percentage widths, and viewport sizes.

## Width Utilities

| Class | CSS Equivalent | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `w-16` | `4rem` (64px) | Fixed width from spacing scale |
| `w-1/2` | `50%` | Half of parent container |
| `w-full` | `100%` | 100% of parent width |
| `w-screen` | `100vw` | 100% of viewport width |
| `w-auto` | `auto` | Natural content width |
| `max-w-md` | `28rem` | Maximum width constraint |
| `min-w-0` | `min-width: 0;` | Prevents flex items from overflowing |

## Height Utilities
- `h-64` (16rem), `h-full` (100%), `h-screen` (100vh), `h-dvh` (100 dynamic viewport height, great for mobile browsers!)

slides.title: Positioning: Relative, Absolute & Fixed
slides.content:
# Positioning Elements 📍 Control document flow and coordinate positioning using Tailwind's position utilities. ## Position Classes - `static` — Standard document flow (`position: static`) - `relative` — Establishes positioning context for children - `absolute` — Positioned relative to nearest positioned ancestor - `fixed` — Fixed relative to the browser viewport - `sticky` — Sticks when reaching a scroll threshold ## Placement Utilities: Inset & Offsets - `top-0`, `bottom-0`, `left-0`, `right-0` - `inset-0` (`top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0;`) - `inset-x-0` (left: 0; right: 0;), `inset-y-0` (top: 0; bottom: 0;) ```html_not
```

slides.title: Sticky Headers & Navigation
slides.content:
# Sticky Positioning in Action 📌 A sticky element acts like `relative` until the viewport reaches its offset, then locks in place like `fixed`. ```html_not
DevApp
Features Pricing Contact
``` > ⚠️ **Gotcha with `sticky`:** If any ancestor element has `overflow: hidden`, `sticky` will fail to lock!

slides.title: Z-Index & Stacking Context
slides.content:
# Stacking Order with Z-Index 📚

The `z-*` utilities control the 3D stacking order of elements on the page.

## Default Z-Index Scale

| Class | CSS Value | Typical Component Target |
|---|---|---|
| `z-0` | `0` | Base content level |
| `z-10` | `10` | Elevated cards, sticky table headers |
| `z-20` | `20` | Dropdowns, tooltips |
| `z-30` | `30` | Floating action buttons (FAB) |
| `z-40` | `40` | Backdrop overlays, drawers |
| `z-50` | `50` | Navigation bars, modals, dialogs |
| `z-auto` | `auto` | Browser default stack |

> 💡 **Remember:** `z-index` only takes effect on elements with an explicit position (`relative`, `absolute`, `fixed`, `sticky`).

slides.title: Overflow & Visibility
slides.content:
# Handling Overflow & Clipping 🌊

Control what happens when content exceeds its container's boundaries.

## Overflow Classes

- `overflow-auto` — Shows scrollbars only when content exceeds dimensions
- `overflow-hidden` — Clips overflowing content
- `overflow-scroll` — Always forces scrollbars
- `overflow-x-auto` — Horizontal scrolling table or carousel
- `overflow-y-auto` — Scrollable sidebar or chat thread

## Visibility vs Display

- `invisible` (`visibility: hidden;`) — Element is hidden but retains its dimensions in layout.
- `hidden` (`display: none;`) — Element is completely removed from document layout.

slides.quizQuestion: What is the difference between `hidden` and `invisible` in Tailwind CSS?
quizOptions: There is no difference; they are aliases for each other
`hidden` sets display: none removing the space, while `invisible` hides the element but preserves its space
`invisible` removes the element from DOM completely, while `hidden` only reduces opacity to 0
`hidden` applies to desktop only, while `invisible` applies to mobile only

slides.content:
# Top Layout Gotchas & Solutions 🛠️ ## 1. Flex Child Text Overflowing A long string inside a flex item blows out the container width. **Fix:** Add `min-w-0` to the flex child and `truncate` to the text: ```html_not

Super long email string here that won't break layout...

``` ## 2. Margin Collapsing Standard CSS vertical margins collapse into one another. **Fix:** Use Flexbox/Grid with `gap-*` instead of vertical margins (`my-*`).

slides.title: Summary of Layout & Spacing
slides.content:
# Summary: Layout & Spacing 📋

## Key Takeaways
- **Containers** give structured max-width boundaries; pair with `mx-auto px-4`.
- **Flexbox** handles 1D directional alignment with `flex`, `flex-col`, `justify-*`, and `items-*`.
- **Grid** delivers 2D responsive arrangements with `grid-cols-*`, `col-span-*`, and `gap-*`.
- **Spacing Scale** provides mathematical rhythm where `1 = 0.25rem` (4px).
- **Positioning** provides layers with `relative`, `absolute`, and `z-*`.
